description: This file defines the 'ModuleStatusChange' class, which is an event class representing a change in the status of a module within the OrangeHRM system. It encapsulates the previous and current module states and extends a base Event class.

classes.name: ModuleStatusChange
classes.description: An event class indicating a change in the status of a module, containing references to previous and current Module objects.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the previous and current Module instances related to the status change.

methods.name: getPreviousModule
methods.description: Returns the Module instance representing the previous state.

methods.name: getCurrentModule
methods.description: Returns the Module instance representing the current state.
